COLA in 30 seconds

Why your benefit changes each year.

01

It protects buying power

COLA raises Social Security and SSI benefits when measured prices rise, helping benefits keep pace with inflation.

02

Three months set the rate

SSA compares the average CPI-W for July, August, and September with the prior comparison period.

03

Your net change matters

The COLA raises your gross benefit. Medicare premiums and other deductions affect what reaches your account.

The three-month formula

Follow the data that sets the COLA.

SSA compares the average CPI-W for July, August, and September with the same quarter from the last year a COLA was determined. The final percentage is announced after all three months are available.
